description: Show the time you spent coding, by language, project, editor and operating system, from WakaTime

token.description: Your personal OAuth token, not the secret API key: WakaTime made API keys write-only. Open wakatime.com/oauth while signed in and copy the token under "Your secret OAuth token".
token.label: WakaTime Personal Token

editors_range.label: Period
editors_range.tooltip: The period these numbers cover. Sections with the same period share one request to WakaTime. Long periods (last year, all time) can take WakaTime a while to compute: the card then shows the last numbers it had.

languages_ignore.description: Comma-separated list of languages to hide
